summary: RemoveDirectoryA wrapper with error reporting. Calls RemoveDirectoryA(lpPathName); on success treats LastError as 0, otherwise captures GetLastError(). If the resulting error code is zero, returns 0 (success). Otherwise hands the error code to ErrorIDLookupTable (0058af5c) and returns -1 (failure).

local_names.lpPathName: path of the directory to remove, forwarded to RemoveDirectoryA
local_names.LastError: error code captured from GetLastError when the removal fails

operations.description: Invoke RemoveDirectoryA(lpPathName) through its IAT thunk at 0x0059E210; a non-zero result marks success.
When RemoveDirectoryA returns non-zero, LastError is set to 0; otherwise LastError is captured from GetLastError().
Invoke GetLastError() through its IAT thunk at 0x0059E188 to obtain the failure code after a failed removal.
When LastError is zero (success or no error captured), the function returns 0 early.
Hand the error code to ErrorIDLookupTable (0058af5c) to report or translate the OS error.
